title: Safe Base
tagline: Our project showcases seamless web authentication and account abstraction capabilities utilizing Safe SDK and we will be building it for the Base main net.
description:
We are building an extension which uses the safe auth kit powered by web3auth for login id creation and safe SDK for account abstraction considering there is no extension which uses safe SDK and we are building it for the base chain. 
This helps the user to store the assets safely and securely in the base chain and account abstraction helps in security and less gas fee transaction.
how_its_made:
We are using the following tech stack to build it:
1. Safe auth kit  for social login which is powered by we3auth
2. Safe SDk for account abstraction
3. we are building it on the Base chain
4. This project uses the covalent APIs to fetch the balance and assets
5. This extension can be used to connect dapps
